 {"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_variation7.phpt","function":"<global>","line":18,"var":"regex feature support","code":"Testing mb_ereg() : usage variations","note":"The mbregex engine accepts rich user patterns with grouped subexpressions and quantifiers."},
 {"step":2,"file":"oniguruma/src/regint.h","function":"<global>","line":63,"var":"USE_STUBBORN_CHECK_CAPTURES_IN_EMPTY_REPEAT","code":"#define USE_STUBBORN_CHECK_CAPTURES_IN_EMPTY_REPEAT","note":"The build enables special handling for empty repeats with captures, which is the code path referenced by the crash report."},
 {"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5455,"var":"body","code":"OnigLen d = node_min_byte_len(body, env);","note":"A quantifier body that can match empty is detected by minimum-byte-length analysis."},
 {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5457,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"When the minimum length is zero, the compiler invokes the recursive emptiness classifier on the body node."},
 {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"switch (NODE_TYPE(node)) {","note":"The classifier traverses the attacker-controlled AST for alternation, quantifier, and memory nodes."},
 {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4935,"var":"NODE_BODY(node)","code":"if (NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)) { return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC; }","note":"Recursive capture bodies are classified as BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC, the special case that the vulnerable path handles differently."},
 {"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regexec.c","function":"STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC","line":2063,"var":"runtime empty-check stack","code":"#define STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM_REC(isnull,sid,s,reg) do { ... }","note":"The generated execution path later consumes this classification in recursion-aware stack inspection."}
]
Path('candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
